select * from screening
and goods_name like concat('%', #{goodsName}, '%')
and hall_name like concat('%', #{hallName}, '%')
and goods_id = #{goodsId}
order by start_time desc
mapper.update: update screening set available_seats = #{availableSeats} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select max(cast(substring(hall_name, 1, length(hall_name) - 2) as unsigned)) from screening
mapper.insert: insert into screening (goods_id, goods_name, hall_name, screen_type, start_time, end_time, price, total_seats, available_seats) values (#{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{hallName}, #{screenType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{price}, #{totalSeats}, #{availableSeats})
mapper.select: select * from screening where goods_id = #{goodsId} and start_time > now() order by start_time asc limit 1
mapper.update: update screening set goods_id = #{goodsId}, goods_name = #{goodsName}, hall_name = #{hallName}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, price = #{price}, total_seats = #{totalSeats}, available_seats = #{availableSeats}, screen_type = #{screenType} where id = #{id}
